Egg and cress, ham and mustard, and cucumber with cream cheese on soft white bread, crusts off, cut into triangles. Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, mash with 2 tbsp mayo and a handful of cress. Spread 150g cream cheese on bread and layer with thin cucumber. Use 12 slices soft white bread in total, cut off the crusts and cut into triangles.
the weekend at Julie's dad's farm
Aged cheddar, a soft washed rind and farmhouse butter with oatcakes, apple slices and a jar of chutney.
Sandy's audition capsicum and feta dip
Sandy's audition for the role she didn't get

Smoky roast red capsicum blitzed with feta, Greek yoghurt and chilli, served with seeded crackers. Char 2 red capsicums under a hot grill for 15 minutes, cover for 10 minutes, then peel and seed. Blitz with 150g feta, 100g Greek yoghurt, 1 garlic clove, half a tsp chilli flakes and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth. Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with oil and serve with 200g seeded crackers.
M: Dry-brined chicken with butter and lemon under the skin, roasted at 220C then 180C, rested, potatoes roasted in the fat.
Steam sliced pastrami 10 minutes until glossy, pile on seeded rye with yellow mustard, a full sour on the side.
W: Julie's kitchen on a weekend off
Cream scones (self-raising flour, cream, sugar) baked at 220C for 12 minutes, split, filled with macerated strawberries and softly whipped cream.
K: the lunch where George first meets Dorothy

Smoky black tea brewed strong, served in glasses with lemon slices and a spoon of jam on the side, the Russian way. Brew 4 tsp loose black tea in 1L just-boiled water for 4 minutes, strain into 4 glasses. Serve with lemon slices and a small dish of cherry jam on the side for stirring in, the Russian Tea Room way.

dishes.make_ahead: Salt the chicken the night before

Mix the butter with lemon zest and thyme and push under the skin.

Rest before carving.

veg.make_ahead: Make the lemon thyme butter up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Trim the cauliflower, keep it whole and boil for 8 minutes, then drain and dry well.
Mix the butter with lemon zest, thyme leaves and the salt and spread it all over the cauliflower, pushing it between the florets.
Roast at 200C with the potatoes and the halved lemon tossed in the oil.
Add the cannellini beans to the tray and roast until the cauliflower is deep golden.
Cut into wedges and serve.
Mix the flour, 200ml of the cream and some of the sugar to a soft dough.
Pat out, cut 4 rounds and bake at 220C.
Toss the strawberries with sugar.
Whip the remaining cream softly.
Split the scones and fill with berries and cream.

s.note: Egg and cress, ham and mustard, and cucumber with cream cheese on soft white bread, crusts off, cut into triangles.
s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, mash with 2 tbsp mayo and a handful of cress. Spread 150g cream cheese on bread and layer with thin cucumber. Use 12 slices soft white bread in total, cut off the crusts and cut into triangles.

s.n: Sandy's audition capsicum and feta dip
s.note: Smoky roast red capsicum blitzed with feta, Greek yoghurt and chilli, served with seeded crackers.
s.how: Char 2 red capsicums under a hot grill for 15 minutes, cover for 10 minutes, then peel and seed. Blitz with 150g feta, 100g Greek yoghurt, 1 garlic clove, half a tsp chilli flakes and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth. Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with oil and serve with 200g seeded crackers.

m.note: Lemon butter roast chicken with potatoes roasted in the fat
m.how: Dry-brine a 1.8kg chicken overnight. Push 50g butter mixed with lemon zest and thyme under the skin. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 180C for 50 minutes, with 1kg halved potatoes in the tray. Rest 15 minutes before carving.

w.note: Cream scones split and filled with strawberries and whipped cream
w.how: Mix 300g self-raising flour with 200ml cream and 2 tbsp sugar to a soft dough. Pat out, cut 4 rounds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Toss 500g sliced strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar. Whip 200ml cream softly, split the scones and fill.

d.note: Smoky black tea brewed strong, served in glasses with lemon slices and a spoon of jam on the side, the Russian way.
d.how: Brew 4 tsp loose black tea in 1L just-boiled water for 4 minutes, strain into 4 glasses. Serve with lemon slices and a small dish of cherry jam on the side for stirring in, the Russian Tea Room way.
